name: Shandong Hi-tech Spring Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Hi-tech Spring Material Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lithium battery electrolyte materials and consumer chemicals China and internationally. It offers dimethyl carbonate, ethyl methyl carbonate, diethyl carbonate, propene carbonate, ethylene carbonate, propylene glycol, 1,3-butanediol glycol, 1,2-hexanediol glycol, 1,2-pentanediol glycol, dipropylene glycol, tripropylene glycol, and ethylene glycol. The company's products are used in new energy and lithium batteries; beauty cosmetics and personal care; flavors or fragrances; food additives; basic chemicals; and human medicines, veterinary medicines, and pesticides.
